questions.q: Tell me about your telecalling work. What product or service did you call about, and how many calls did you make in a day?
questions.looks_for: Real product (loans, insurance, courses, real estate), inbound or outbound, daily call count, targets, and tools like a dialer or CRM.
questions.te: మీ telecalling పని గురించి చెప్పండి. ఏ product లేదా service గురించి call చేసేవారు? రోజుకి ఎన్ని calls చేసేవారు?
questions.hi: अपने telecalling काम के बारे में बताइए। आप किस product या service के लिए call करते थे, और दिन में कितनी calls करते थे?

questions.q: Tell me about one call where a customer was not interested at first but later agreed. What did you say?
questions.looks_for: Specific call, listened to the reason, gave a relevant benefit, handled the doubt, set follow-up, and the final outcome.
questions.te: మొదట customer కి ఆసక్తి లేదు, కానీ తర్వాత ఒప్పుకున్న ఒక call గురించి చెప్పండి. మీరు ఏం మాట్లాడారు?
questions.hi: किसी ऐसी call के बारे में बताइए जहाँ customer पहले interested नहीं था लेकिन बाद में मान गया। आपने क्या कहा?

questions.q: What should you say in the first 15 seconds of a sales call so that the customer does not cut the call?
questions.looks_for: Polite greeting, own name and company, clear reason, quick benefit, asks permission to continue; short and friendly.
questions.te: Customer call cut చేయకుండా ఉండాలంటే sales call లో మొదటి 15 seconds లో ఏం మాట్లాడాలి?
questions.hi: Sales call के पहले 15 seconds में क्या बोलना चाहिए ताकि customer call न काटे?

questions.q: Why is it important to write notes in the CRM or sheet after every call?
questions.looks_for: Remembers what was said, right follow-up time, team can see history, avoids repeat questions, helps reports and targets.
questions.te: ప్రతి call తర్వాత CRM లేదా sheet లో notes రాయడం ఎందుకు ముఖ్యం?
questions.hi: हर call के बाद CRM या sheet में notes लिखना क्यों ज़रूरी है?

questions.q: If a customer says do not call me again, what should you do and why?
questions.looks_for: Respects it, apologises politely, marks do-not-call in the system, does not argue; follows rules and protects company name.
questions.te: Customer మళ్ళీ call చేయొద్దు అంటే మీరు ఏం చేయాలి, ఎందుకు?
questions.hi: अगर customer कहे कि मुझे दोबारा call मत करना, तो आपको क्या करना चाहिए और क्यों?

questions.q: A customer is angry because another caller from your company promised a free gift that never came. What would you say on the call?
questions.looks_for: Apologises, listens, does not blame the colleague, checks records, gives honest information, raises a complaint with a timeline, keeps it polite.
questions.te: మీ company నుంచి ఇంకొకరు free gift ఇస్తామని చెప్పారు, కానీ రాలేదని customer కోపంగా ఉన్నారు. Call లో మీరు ఏం చెప్తారు?
questions.hi: Customer गुस्से में है क्योंकि आपकी company के किसी और caller ने free gift का वादा किया था जो कभी नहीं आया। आप call पर क्या कहेंगे?

questions.q: Why do you want this telecaller job, when can you join (say your notice period clearly), and what monthly salary do you expect?
questions.looks_for: Clear reason linked to the work, states notice period or joining date in days or weeks, and gives an expected monthly salary figure or range without dodging.
questions.te: ఈ telecaller job మీకు ఎందుకు కావాలి? ఎప్పుడు join అవ్వగలరు (notice period స్పష్టంగా చెప్పండి)? నెలకు ఎంత జీతం ఆశిస్తున్నారు?
questions.hi: आपको यह telecaller job क्यों चाहिए? आप कब join कर सकते हैं (notice period साफ़ बताइए)? और महीने की कितनी salary चाहिए?
